recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-32529 unless a future PA decision changes the broader identifier uniqueness guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-32529 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by Patient Administration and requested a RelatedPerson.identifier usage comment explaining that identifiers might not be unique across RelatedPerson instances when one human individual is represented by multiple role, period, or relationship resources.
initial_application: Git commit 2d475165fb612234ae5e27d56cf11aea56883876 explicitly applied FHIR-32529 by adding the RelatedPerson.identifier comment. The Jira comment explains the publisher-safe wording change from 'may not' to 'might not'.
additional_context: RelatedPerson is active in source/fhir.ini and owned by PA, so source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml is in current build scope. Later FHIR-27164 commit f0c1061b32c8c90986ca85b352d16038b02c3c85 appended user-identity guidance to the same comment without changing the FHIR-32529 sentence. PA 2022-03-02 minutes record the 6-0-0 vote to add the usage comment, and Zulip searches found no conflicting later discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current RelatedPerson.identifier comment already states that RelatedPerson identifiers might not be unique across instances within a system because one human individual may be represented as many different RelatedPerson resources with different roles, periods, or relationships.
